# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment documents generated for the ContosoCrafts versioned report.

- [architecture-diagram.md](architecture-diagram.md) - High-level and component-level architecture diagrams for the web application.
- [dependency-map.md](dependency-map.md) - Declared dependency inventory grouped by functional category.
- [api-service-contracts.md](api-service-contracts.md) - API endpoint catalog, communication patterns, and request sequence.
- [data-architecture.md](data-architecture.md) - Persistence model, entity view, and data ownership summary.
- [configuration-inventory.md](configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, runtime profiles, and settings inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](business-workflows.md) - Core catalog browsing and rating workflows with business rules.
